Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation

v1.0.0Foundry 14.370D&D5e 6.0.6

All-in-one automation.
Built to keep your game moving.

Bring your regions, effects, class features, spells, and combat together in one connected workflow. Built around Foundry’s native D&D5e system and official content, Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation carries an action from the first roll through reactions, damage, applied effects, and follow-up turns.

Play through familiar chat cards, keep control of the decisions, and let the module handle the supported rules and bookkeeping. No rebuilding supported features or configuring every ability individually. Just a cleaner, simpler way for GMs and players to run the game together.

Everything works together

The tools your game needs.
A workflow everyone can follow.

One module brings the supported automation together, so each roll, reaction, and effect can carry the action forward. Choose your table’s pace, keep the decisions in your hands, and let Foundry handle the follow-through.

I.Automated Region Effects

Put it on the map.
Let the area do its work.

Configured Regions handle supported entry, movement, and turn triggers for saves, damage, and effects. Follow-up turns stay connected to the original spell, helping reduce duplicate rolls and forgotten checks. Attached emanations move with their source.

Explore automated Regions →

II.Automated Effect Triggers

Apply the effect.
Remember the follow-through.

Keep lingering spells, monster abilities, and other ongoing effects moving with repeat saves, recurring damage, and configured escape options. The source, save DC, and turn timing stay connected, so the next step arrives when it matters.

Explore Automated Effects →

III.Classes, Subclasses, Spells & Abilities

Your features.
Already part of the flow.

Supported class and subclass features, spells, feats, skills, weapon masteries, and abilities work through native activities and chat cards. Use the official items you already have, with their scaling and resources, without importing replacements or rebuilding each supported feature.

react, and review.

Keep the action and its results together. Correct Advantage, Normal, and Disadvantage while preserving the original dice, make supported adjustments from the card, and review Apply and Undo without hunting through separate tools or repairing the result by hand.

V.Automated Combat & Smart Reactions

Keep combat moving.
Leave room for a reaction.

Connect attacks, saves, damage, healing, and effect application to the same action and recorded targets. Smart Damage and Effect Automation pauses automatic application for supported player or GM reactions, then updates the connected result. Combat tracking and legendary-action reminders help carry the encounter into the next turn.

Before you install

Native Foundry.
Your table’s content.

Built to support official Wizards of the Coast Foundry content

This module adds automation to supported items, activities, and effects from official Wizards of the Coast content for Foundry VTT, including the Player’s Handbook and Monster Manual. It does not create, replace, or supply that source material. You must obtain and install the relevant content separately; books, compendiums, spells, and creature stat blocks are not included with this module.

Version 1.0.0

For Foundry VTT 14, verified with 14.370, and D&D5e 6.0.5+, verified with 6.0.6. Install and enable Automated Conditions 5e and Dice So Nice! alongside the module. Keep an active GM connected for shared resource, effect, and HP operations.

Install through the manifest

In Foundry’s Setup screen, open Add-on Modules → Install Module and use the installation manifest. Enable the module and its dependencies in your world, then refresh all GM and player clients.

Choose compatible workflows

These features use native D&D5e cards. Other automation packages, including Midi-QOL, or item macros that replace the same workflow can conflict. D&D Beyond imports are not verified and may need their activities or effects configured to match the documented sources. The detailed guides explain supported features and table-managed steps.
